positions.title: Software Quality Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Managed SDET and QA Engineers on supporting the qualification of Dropbox products through a mix of
manual and automated, agile testing processes aiming to find defects fast and early.
- Identified quality metrics and engaged with stakeholders across the organization to set and drive quality goals.
- Led the automation of existing manual test processes. Set the vision and goals for test automation and CI/CD.
- Identified process improvements, set and drove goals to increase teams’ testing efficiency and productivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Strategic Planning · Agile Testing · Test Automation · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Project Management

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Manager
positions.description:
- Built and led QA teams with a mix of on-site and remote members for Amazon Business, Fresh and Alexa.
- Defined the vision for software quality. Developed requirements in collaboration with product, engineering and
infrastructure and identified appropriate quality metrics, testing processes and agile methodologies.
- Drove the automation of manual tests and the transformation from waterfall to agile, shift-left testing strategies.
- Identified process improvements for CI/CD, set and drove goals for optimizing testing costs and coverage.

positions.title: Lead Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Prior to my promotion to SQA Manager, I led the testing efforts for the release of Amazon Business to seven international marketplaces, coordinating and working with stakeholders in different time zones.

positions.title: Team Leader, Software Development Engineer–Test
positions.description: Led a team of SDET building frameworks and tooling for test automation and continuous integration.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer–Test
positions.description: Prior to my promotion, I designed and implemented test automation for network traffic analysis equipment.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Developed an e-Commerce platform based on Java/Spring and integration with Salesforce for SunPower Corp.

positions.title: Research Associate – Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Research and Development mainly focused on Machine Learning and Fuzzy Systems. Application to the development of a Recommender System for B2C e-Commerce portals and Security of Public Infrastructures based on Intelligent Agents.

Results published on several international journals and conference proceedings.
